div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
adminForward only issues a warning once it resolves an employee:
dto.targetEmployeeId (unknown id = 409 EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND), else the
user matching recordCreatedBy. If that fallback lookup misses, the
correction still becomes FORWARDED and no warning is written.
Re-forwarding an already FORWARDED correction sends a second warning.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Acknowledging or editing a revoked warning fails 404 WARNING_NOT_FOUND -
both load through findByIdAndRemovedAtIsNull. No un-acknowledge endpoint
exists, so Acknowledged never returns to Unacknowledged.
user_audit_logs gets WARNING_SENT / UPDATE / WARNING_ACKNOWLEDGED /
WARNING_REVOKED only when the row really changes - the idempotent loops
(re-acknowledge, re-revoke, PUT with no diff) write no audit row.
